dedupe_keys.name: historical operation data of 256 reservoirs in contiguous united states

description: Historical Operation Data of 256 Reservoirs in Contiguous United States is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Chen, Yanan (deposited on HydroShare). Reservoir operations face persistent challenges due to increasing water demand, more frequent extreme events, and stricter environmental requirements. Historical operation records are used to investigate real-world reservoir operations, which integrate prescribed operation rules, empirical knowledge of operators, and regulatory response to extreme events. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2025-01-27 and last updated 2026-03-30; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
